# Field Container

## Summary
The label-and-control pairing that lays out one field in a form.

## Shape
Owns the relationship between a label and its control: `@label` with `@fieldId` for the
assistive-technology association, `@tag` to render as a `<label>` or a `<div>` depending on
whether the control inside is natively labelable, and `@vertical`, `@inline`,
`@horizontalLabelSize` and `@centeredDisplay` for arrangement. `@icon` with `@iconWidth`/
`@iconHeight` prefixes the label. Validation text is deliberately not here — that belongs to
the control, so the two never render an error twice.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/field-container/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { FieldContainer } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
